notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W} due to Will's ability, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.
